title: Pierre McCann (Scrum Master, PMP) on finishing the audiobook — 'I feel like your book reveals a pathway for me to take that north star and scale it up'
summary: An agile practitioner writes directly to Eric after listening to the book. He says it takes what he learned from agility — the respect for people that makes teams work — and applies it to a broader domain, and that it shows him how to scale a career goal he arrived at years ago through a lot of soul-searching.
blockquote: I've got a career north star that I have had for years, and it was the product of a lot of soul-searching: I want to work with technology teams made of smart, kind people who tackle wicked problems and, in solving them, create significant novel value in the world. I feel like your book reveals a pathway for me to take that north star and scale it up.
attribution_title: Scrum Master & Project Manager · MBA, PMP, CSM
